primaryLinks.altText: PROFESSIONAL BIOGRAPHYBorn in 1997 in Belgrade, Serbia. She earned both her Bachelor’s (2021) and Master’s (2022) degrees in Painting from the Faculty of Fine Arts at the University of Arts in Belgrade, under the mentorship of Professor Dobrica Bisenić. Since 2024, she has been pursuing her Doctoral of Arts (PhD) degree at the same institution, currently under the mentorship of Assistant Professor Nataša Kokić.Her work has been recognized with prestigious accolades, including the First Prize for Drawing at the 7th International Biennial of Drawing and Graphic Arts (2026). She is a two-time recipient of the "Dositeja" scholarship, awarded by the Fund for Young Talents of the Republic of Serbia (2021, 2022).To date, she has presented four solo exhibitions and participated in numerous group exhibitions across the country and the region. Since 2023, she has held the official status of an Independent Artist.
